a.lede: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
a.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?

b.lede: Move follows admission of affair with woman alleged to be Chinese spy and reported relationship with employee Business live – latest updates Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive of Nvidia after reports of extramarital affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company employee. He will be replaced on an interim basis by Nvidia’s chief financial officer, Colette Kress,
b.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after alleged affairs
